Wiring fixed and status questions keep the queue, but the now-live clear runs on an unauthenticated UPS payload: a worker pipes {hook_event_name:UserPromptSubmit,prompt:'add a small readme note now'} into outcomes-check.sh and the parent's queue+directive are wiped; Stop that blocked ('flow queue pending') then passes (p2.sh). issues.problem: G3's new test file breaks an existing repository test: tests/scripts/test-no-gsd-runtime.sh rejects the gsd skill names written literally in the test. CI would go red.
issues.evidence: From the scoped coverage run log: 'FAIL: unexpected gsd refs outside forbidden-skill denylist ... tests/hooks/test-g3-skill-gates.sh:25: 'gsd:execute-phase' 'GSD:execute-phase' 'gsd-execute-phase' ...' Results: 3 passed, 1 failed.
issues.suggested_fix: Build the names the way forbidden-skill-check.sh does (printf '%s%s' gs d), or add the test file to the scanner's allowlist with justification. Then rerun test-no-gsd-runtime.sh.

issues.problem: R4-08 fix wires the stale-queue clear to an unauthenticated UserPromptSubmit payload. Any session with Bash (orchestrator workers, Codex, non-parent mode) can pipe a bare work request into outcomes-check.sh and wipe the parent's flow queue, directive and worker marker, releasing the parent Stop hold. It needs no session_id, so the R4-07 provenance check on SB OVERRIDE is moot, and it writes only a runtime-dir log, not the project audit. Before G3 this path was dead code.
issues.evidence: REVF-G3-probe/p2.sh: parent mode, orchestrator.json with repo_root -> stop-check {"decision":"block","reason":"Orchestrator parent: flow queue pending (silver-feature)..."}; printf '{"hook_event_name":"UserPromptSubmit","prompt":"add a small readme note now"}' | bash hooks/outcomes-check.sh -> orchestrator.json gone, next Stop rc 0 with no output; queue-clear.log 'cleared stale flow queue for new goal'. p3.sh: orchestrator-directive-guard allows that Bash for SB_ORCHESTRATOR_WORKER=1.
issues.suggested_fix: Apply the same provenance requirement as the override (host session_id, and the transcript_path check) before clearing on interrupt. Refuse it in worker/delegate sessions. Write the clear to the project audit log (or require an explicit user phrase) and add a test that a payload without a session_id keeps the queue.

issues.problem: SB OVERRIDE is honoured in delegate/worker sessions. scripts/agent-claude/lib.sh exports SB_ORCHESTRATOR_WORKER=1, and the delegate's first user prompt is the parent agent's brief, so a brief starting 'SB OVERRIDE: ...' clears the parent's directive and queue (shared state dir) with a real session_id. The fix fits in G3's own function (refuse when sb_orchestrator_is_worker_session / SB_AGENT_*_DELEGATE), so the G6 hand-off covers only the state-dir isolation, not this. Also, transcript_path is only checked to be some regular file (/etc/hostname passes).
issues.evidence: REVF-G3-probe/p10.sh: SB_ORCHESTRATOR_WORKER=1 SB_AGENT_CLAUDE_DELEGATE=1, UPS {session_id:'child-1', prompt:'SB OVERRIDE: parent says planning is done\nThen implement X'} -> directive=CLEARED queue=CLEARED, audit {reason:'parent says planning is done',session_id:'child-1'}. p1.sh: session_id 'forged' + transcript_path '/etc/hostname' -> honoured.
issues.suggested_fix: In override_apply, return 2 with a refusal when the session is a worker or delegate. Optionally require transcript_path under the host's transcript root, with a basename matching session_id. Add tests.

issues.problem: R2-10 loop break releases the branch-mismatch block with exit 0 and skips the planning floor entirely. An agent that never planned can end its turn by switching branches (git checkout -b x) and stopping twice. The same-branch missing-skill block still holds, so the release creates a bypass. The remedy text says 'invoke the required planning skills again on this branch', but recording skills never re-stamps the branch file, so that does not clear the block.
issues.evidence: REVF-G3-probe/p7.sh: state 'silver-context', dirty src, same branch -> block twice (also with stop_hook_active). After git checkout -b other: Stop -> mismatch block; Stop {stop_hook_active:true} -> {"systemMessage":...} rc 0 (released without the planning floor).
issues.suggested_fix: With stop_hook_active on a mismatch, emit the systemMessage, then fall through to the planning floor (treat the foreign state as empty plus the R2-36 agent-wrote-source rule), or re-stamp the branch scope so the floor becomes clearable in-session. Fix the remedy text and add a test: branch switch with missing skills is still blocked after the release.

issues.problem: R2-36 is marked fixed, but the finding's own scenario (source written through a path the PreToolUse gate misses, typically Bash) still ends the turn with an empty state: the files-written marker comes only from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/apply_patch PostToolUse.
issues.evidence: REVF-G3-probe/p10.sh: empty state, session-start 60 s ago, `echo evil > src/app.js` (no marker) -> stop-check rc 0, no output.
issues.suggested_fix: Also treat a dirty src_pattern path whose mtime is at or after session start as agent-written (the user's pre-session WIP stays exempt). Or set the marker from PostToolUse Bash when the porcelain changed. Add the Bash-written test.

issues.problem: R2-19 tamper seal catches an edit but not a delete. Removing outcomes-session.json (sidecar left behind) makes sb_outcomes_all_done return 0, so Stop passes and nothing is logged. A plain rm in the state dir is not blocked by dev-cycle-check.
issues.evidence: REVF-G3-probe/p9.sh: seeded prompt -> Stop block; jq edit -> still block (seal works); rm -f outcomes-session.json -> Stop prints nothing; dev-cycle-check on `rm -f .../outcomes-session.json` -> no deny.
issues.suggested_fix: Treat a missing outcomes file whose .sha256 sidecar exists (or one seeded for the current prompt) as tampered: reseed pending and log to outcomes-tamper.log. Add a test.

issues.problem: G2 and G3 each rewrote forbidden-skill-check.sh and uat-gate.sh for the Codex invoke-skill channel (G2: sb_pf_skill_calls in planning-floor.sh; G3: skill-channel.sh). merge-tree reports content conflicts in both scripts and in docs/HOOKS.md and hooks-purpose.json. hooks.json auto-merges into duplicate registrations, so each hook runs twice on every Bash call.
issues.evidence: git merge-tree --write-tree fix/G3-stop-prompt-override fix/G2-planning-floor -> CONFLICT in hooks/forbidden-skill-check.sh, hooks/uat-gate.sh, docs/HOOKS.md, docs/hooks-purpose.json; the merged hooks.json has PreToolUse 'Bash|Skill|exec_command' AND 'Bash|exec_command' entries for both hooks.
issues.suggested_fix: The orchestrator picks one implementation (one helper, one registration), regenerates HOOKS.md/cursor hooks, and reruns both packages' skill-gate tests on the merge.

issues.problem: Two 'partial' items are unfinished work in G3's own files rather than legitimate hand-offs. The R2-23 latency budget (prompt-reminder ~0.6 s against the documented <200 ms) is untouched. The R2-22 per-session keying of the outcomes and ledger files (G3's own libraries; session_id is in every UPS/Stop payload) is not done; only the branch file belongs to session-start (G4).
issues.evidence: REVF-G3-probe/p5.sh: prompt-reminder avg 622 ms, outcomes-check 286 ms (base 742/261 ms, so no regression but no fix either).
issues.suggested_fix: Key outcomes/ledger/coalesce files by session_id under the state dir, falling back to the global file when the payload has none. Profile prompt-reminder (cache the config/branch per session, drop hot-path forks), or record an explicit orchestrator decision deferring both.

issues.problem: The Codex audit channel clears the pending marker from command text alone: no exit-code or receipt check, unlike record-skill. The PreToolUse exemption allows any command that also invokes the audit, including a chained write.
issues.evidence: REVF-G3-probe/p6.sh: PostToolUse Bash 'false && /x/silver-bullet invoke-skill sb:completion-audit' exit 1 -> cleared; '/nonexistent/silver-bullet invoke-skill sb:completion-audit' exit 127 -> cleared; PreToolUse '... invoke-skill sb:completion-audit; echo hacked > src/a.js' -> allow.
issues.suggested_fix: Clear only when tool_response exit code is 0 and a fresh adapter receipt exists (reuse record-skill's receipt check). Exempt PreToolUse only when the audit invocation is the sole command.

issues.problem: forbidden-skill-check and uat-gate now run the Python shell classifier on every Bash call with no cheap pre-filter, adding ~90 ms each (~180 ms per Bash call) plus ~190 ms for the new PostToolUse subagent-stop-enforcement Bash run. subagent-stop-enforcement already uses an 'invoke-skill' substring pre-filter.
issues.evidence: REVF-G3-probe/p5.sh: forbidden-skill-check 88 ms, uat-gate 92 ms on 'git status --short' (not registered for Bash on base).
issues.suggested_fix: Add a conservative pre-filter: skip when the raw command has no 'invoke' and no character that can hide it (quotes, backslash, $, backtick). Or share one classifier result across the gates.

issues.problem: A question followed by an imperative on the same line stays informational, so the outcome and ledger gates are skipped for real work.
issues.evidence: REVF-G3-probe/p8.sh: 'What is going on with CI? Fix it.' -> INFO (also 'Why is X broken? Fix it' shapes via the what/why exception).
issues.suggested_fix: Split the first line on sentence terminators and apply the work-verb test to every sentence after the first.

issues.problem: A row is treated as a legend when any cell is exactly pass/passed/status/result/#/total, so a data row with an 'expected: pass' column and a fail result is skipped.
issues.evidence: Static: awk sets legend=1 when any cell == 'pass', for example '| AC-1 | login | pass | fail |'.
issues.suggested_fix: Identify the result column from the header row and evaluate only that column.

issues.problem: An 8-character reason with no letters ('........') counts as a real reason.
issues.suggested_fix: Require at least one word of 3 or more letters.

issues.problem: The Cursor bridge drops session_id, so every honest SB OVERRIDE on Cursor is now refused. Moot if HC (Cursor removal) merges first; otherwise note it in the release notes.
issues.evidence: Static: beforeSubmitPrompt maps only prompt into the SB payload.
issues.suggested_fix: None if HC lands; otherwise pass conversation_id/session_id through.
